purpose: Separate future human-reviewed thread-change evaluation; no existing verified change labels
constraints: Both emails must belong to the same verified source thread and be chronologically ordered.
All thread and cross-source leakage components stay in one partition across classification and thread-change tasks.
Entity identity must be established by evidence; shared keywords alone do not link actions, meetings, or documents.
Each change label requires exact authored evidence in the later message; historical state requires earlier evidence.
NO_CHANGE is exclusive. Unresolved identity, scope, ordering, or state uses empty change_labels and needs_review=true.
Deadline direction requires two comparable due points for the same action or deliverable; a meeting date is not a deadline.
DOCUMENT_DELIVERED requires explicit delivery evidence; a filename or attachment mention alone does not prove the requested document was delivered.
Gold is independent human-adjudicated test data and never used for training, threshold tuning, or rule/prompt modification.
